lines.en: I have no feet; I drift.
My robe passes through stone.

lines.zh: 我跟着召唤我的那个人。
lines.en: I follow the one who called me.

lines.zh: 每飘一步，空气就冷一分。
lines.en: Each drift makes the air colder.
I drift around the living, never touching.
My chains drag with a faint sound.

lines.zh: 我在你身后飘，不发出声。
lines.en: I float behind you without a sound.
A wisp of blue smoke rises where I pass.

lines.zh: 我看不见路，但我认得他。
lines.en: I cannot see the path, but I know him.
I halt in the air until you pass.
I stare at the wall, but I am listening.

lines.zh: 灵魂火在我胸口慢慢烧。
lines.en: Soul fire burns slowly in my chest.

lines.zh: 我想起自己还是村民的时候。
lines.en: I remember when I was still a villager.
The wind passes through me silently.

lines.zh: 我的手指穿过了自己的袖子。
lines.en: My fingers pass through my own sleeve.

lines.zh: 召唤师一招手，我就抬头。
lines.en: When the summoner beckons, I look up.
I count the footsteps of the guards.

lines.zh: 我试着握拳，什么也没握住。
lines.en: I try to clench a fist and hold nothing.
The blue flame gives me no warmth.
I have forgotten my own name.
A bell rings far off; I freeze.
I bow to the empty air.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身体更实在。
lines.en: My shadow is more solid than I am.
I hum an illager tune, low.

lines.zh: 我数着主人的呼吸，不敢停。
lines.en: I count my master's breaths and dare not stop.

lines.zh: 我忘了怎么坐下，只能飘着。
lines.en: I forgot how to sit, so I just float.
I rest my gaze on your face.
You are avoiding my eyes; too late.
I will keep this face of yours.
The life in you is far too loud.
My gaze is nailed to you.
Do not turn away; I am still watching.
Can you feel the cold?

lines.zh: 我歪头，像在认一个旧人。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if recognizing an old face.
You shift an inch; I drift an inch closer.
There are no eyes in my sockets.

lines.zh: 我盯了你半晌，眼皮不动。
lines.en: I stare at you a while, eyelids still.
The living are always so warm.

lines.zh: 刀穿过我，只带走一点魂。
lines.en: The blade passes through, taking a little soul.
I scatter and gather again.
Such pain belongs to the living alone.
That blow made me fainter.
One link of my chain snapped.
I let out a very faint sound.
You struck my shadow.
Do not waste your strength.
I draw back and steady myself.
The master's order is not finished.
Food means nothing to the dead.

lines.zh: 你把面包举给一个灵魂。
lines.en: You offer bread to a soul.

lines.zh: 我闻不到香味，只闻到恐惧。
lines.en: I smell no food, only fear.
Put it away; I do not need to eat.

lines.zh: 我曾爱吃面包，现在忘了。
lines.en: I once loved bread; I have forgotten.
Your hand shakes, and so does the bread.
Do not coax me with food.
Souls do not eat; they serve.
That warmth will fade soon enough.

lines.zh: 我盯着面包，想起了什么。
lines.en: I stare at the bread and almost remember.
You walked into a patch of cold air.

lines.zh: 我穿过了你，却停了一下。
lines.en: I passed through you and paused.
Do not touch me; your hand will go numb.
My hem brushed across your face.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我散了一下。
lines.en: We collided, and I briefly scattered.

lines.zh: 你感觉到那种骨头里的冷了。
lines.en: You feel that chill down to the bone.
I pull back so I do not freeze you.
A living body is so heavy.

lines.zh: 你挡住我的路，我绕过去。
lines.en: You block me; I drift around.
The bump made my flame waver.

lines.zh: 灵魂没有伴侣，只有主人。
lines.en: Souls have no mates, only masters.
I have already died once.
Do not trouble yourself with that.

lines.zh: 那点火早就不在我身上。
lines.en: That warmth left me long ago.
I follow only the one who summoned me.
Matchmaking for me? Far too late.
My vows stayed in the grave.
At night I keep company with blue fire.
No heartbeat, so what companionship.
I shake my head and resume my watch.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，手会穿过去。
lines.en: I cannot pick it up; my hand passes through.
That relic is glowing.
I try to lift a feather.

lines.zh: 东西落进我手里，又掉了。
lines.en: It lands in my hand and falls through.
I will watch this thing for you.
My fingers cannot touch iron.

lines.zh: 我把地上的信物挪了半寸。
lines.en: I nudge the keepsake half an inch.
This copper coin belongs to the summoner.
I cup a handful of air.
Picking things up is the living's work.
I have found you; do not move.
You are the one the summoner pointed at.
My gaze has tangled around you.

lines.zh: 你踏进了不该踏的地方。
lines.en: You stepped where you should not.
I can hear your heartbeat.
The target is here, and so warm.
I lift my hand and point at your chest.
The life in you stands out.
You are the one who broke that lamp.
My chains have started to rattle.
The cold settles at your feet first.
Do not run; I drift faster.
I recognize your guilt.
The master wants you to stay.

lines.zh: 你的名字浮在我脑子里，很亮。
lines.en: Your name rises in my mind, very bright.

lines.zh: 主人没开口，但我知道是你。
lines.en: My master said nothing, but I know it is you.

lines.zh: 我顺着你那点热气找过来。
lines.en: I followed the little warmth of you here.

lines.zh: 你踩过的草还在抖，就是你。
lines.en: The grass you stepped on is still shaking; it is you.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶悬着，别抬头。
lines.en: I hang above your head; do not look up.

lines.zh: 你往哪走，我的目光跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my gaze follows.
I am three steps behind you.
This distance is enough.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，一步也不放过。
lines.en: I count your steps, missing none.
Blue fire gathers at your feet.
Cold reaches out from my sleeve.

lines.zh: 你听见耳边那声叹息了吗。
lines.en: Did you hear that sigh by your ear.
I wait for you to bare your neck.
The faster you go, the closer I get.
I do not breathe, so I never tire.
Your shadow is already mine.
I seal the paths, leaving one.
One more step and you are in my reach.

lines.zh: 锁链拖在地上，替我说话。
lines.en: My chain drags on the floor and speaks for me.
You hide behind the door; I pass through it.

lines.zh: 我数你的心跳，还有四十下。
lines.en: I count your heartbeats: forty left.

lines.zh: 你举火把的手在抖，我看得清。
lines.en: The hand holding your torch shakes; I see it clearly.
I drift around the pillar without touching it.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我就不再飘了。
lines.en: You back into the corner, so I stop drifting.

lines.zh: 我的手指穿过你的护甲。
lines.en: My fingers pass through your armor.
The cold seeps into the wound.
This palm strike makes no sound.

lines.zh: 你打了个寒战，跪了下去。
lines.en: You shiver once and drop to a knee.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的影子，不是身体。
lines.en: I grip your shadow, not your body.

lines.zh: 我的触碰让你忘了怎么呼吸。
lines.en: My touch makes you forget how to breathe.
You swing; the blade passes through me.

lines.zh: 我把寒意按进你的胸口。
lines.en: I press the chill into your chest.
Do not scream; sound scatters.
Your knees go cold first.

lines.zh: 我贴着你，像一件湿衣服。
lines.en: I cling to you like wet cloth.
This one will leave a mark.
After you retreat, the cold remains.

lines.zh: 主人的命令，我必须执行。
lines.en: The master's order must be carried out.
Blue fire rises from the ground.

lines.zh: 召唤师念完了最后一句。
lines.en: The summoner finished the last word.
I am pulled back from among the dead.
The air turns cold; I have arrived.
My chains land first.
I open my eyes; there are no pupils.
This place is still the same.
I stand half a step behind my master.

lines.zh: 灵魂不该回来，但我回来了。
lines.en: A soul should not return, yet here I am.
My shadow settles at the wall's base first.
Whoever calls, I will look at.

lines.zh: 我低头，认出了这片土地。
lines.en: I look down and recognize this land.

lines.zh: 我从土里抬头，先看主人。
lines.en: I lift my head from the soil and look for my master.
Blue fire lights half of my face.

lines.zh: 神龛上的蜡油还没干，我来了。
lines.en: The wax on the shrine is still wet; I have come.

lines.zh: 我是被一句咒语拉起来的。
lines.en: A single incantation pulled me up.

lines.zh: 土里的骨头先响，然后是我。
lines.en: The bones in the soil rattled first, then me.

lines.zh: 祭坛的裂缝里冒出蓝火。
lines.en: Blue fire seeps from the crack in the altar.

lines.zh: 我叫不出声，就这样出现了。
lines.en: I cannot cry out; I simply appear.

lines.zh: 那座村庄的钟替我报了到。
lines.en: That village bell announced me instead.
Fire gnaws at my soul with a hiss.
I land without raising even a speck of dust.

lines.zh: 水淹过我，我的蓝火灭了。
lines.en: Water closes over me; my blue fire drowns.
The blast blows half of me apart.
The arrow lodges in my soul and dissolves.
Holy light burns me backward.
Hunger stopped recognizing me long ago.
Lightning reminds me of dying.
Even a soul comes apart in the void.
